# FACILITIES MAN

> Owner-operated facilities management and commercial cleaning across Newcastle, Hunter Valley, Lake Macquarie, Central Coast NSW, with metro support in Sydney, Brisbane and Melbourne.

Site: https://www.facilitiesman.com.au
Contact: support@facilitiesman.com.au | 0450 924 377
ABN: 72 697 453 937
Hours: Monday–Saturday, 7am–7pm
